title: Storagent
tagline: AI-powered on-chain inventory management system using CDP, The Graph & Nillion on Base. 🚀 Tracks stock levels, predicts restocks based on usage, & auto-restocks the best supplier for fast delivery. Fully autonomous or user-confirmed restocking for optimized supply chains!
description:
Storagent is a revolutionary AI-driven inventory management platform on the blockchain with  automation to transform how businesses manage their warehouse inventories. By combining smart contracts, AI-powered decision-making, and advanced analytics, Storagent streamlines inventory processes, ensuring efficiency, transparency, and autonomy. The platform goes beyond traditional inventory systems by incorporating on-chain solutions, trend analysis, and supplier selection into its functionality.
How It Works
	1.	AI-Driven Inventory Monitoring
Storagent continuously tracks inventory levels and usage patterns in real-time. When a product is purchased, the system automatically updates inventory levels. It evaluates historical trends and compares them to predefined thresholds to decide whether restocking is necessary.
	2.	Supplier Selection
When restocking is required, the platform analyzes supplier data and autonomously selects the one with the shortest lead time. Users are notified with all relevant details and must confirm the purchase before Storagent proceeds to restock items autonomously using smart contracts.
	3.	Comprehensive Dashboard
Storagent features a robust dashboard that provides users with insights into inventory usage trends, supplier details, and real-time stock levels. Users can search for suppliers, track inventory, and interact with the smart contract to manage stock levels manually.
	4.	Autonomous Supplier Interaction
The platform employs Playwright scripts to automate purchases from suppliers, minimizing manual intervention and accelerating the restocking process.

Who It’s For
	•	Warehouse Managers: Storagent empowers managers with AI-driven tools to maintain optimal stock levels, automate restocking, and access actionable insights on usage patterns and trends.
	•	Businesses Using On-Chain Technologies: Companies looking for a transparent and decentralized inventory management system can leverage Storagent’s blockchain integration for secure and efficient operations.
	•	Consumers: Customers benefit from the ability to purchase items directly from warehouses while enjoying the flexibility of Web3-based transactions.
Storagent redefines inventory management by merging the power of AI, blockchain, and automation. It eliminates inefficiencies in traditional warehouse operations while offering transparency and security through smart contract integration. With Storagent, businesses can confidently manage inventory levels, make data-driven restocking decisions, and provide a seamless experience for customers—all while leveraging the latest advancements in Web3 technology.

how_its_made:
Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP): The Backbone of Inventory Automation
	•	CDP Agent Kit: Powers the AI agent for monitoring inventory levels, tracking trends, and autonomously selecting suppliers.
	•	CDP Onchain Kit: Provides secure wallet access and enables transparent on-chain inventory operations.
	•	CDP Commerce: Allows consumers to purchase items directly from the warehouse using Web3 payments.

The Graph: Real-Time Data and Analytics
	•	Aggregates and indexes inventory usage trends and supplier lead times.
	•	Enables complex queries, pagination, and event tracking for better insights into inventory and supplier performance.

Nillion: Secure Private Data Storage
	•	Stores sensitive supplier and inventory data securely using decentralized computation.
	•	Performs computations like supplier ranking without exposing raw data.

Browser-use: Automating Supplier Interactions
	•	Automates supplier order placement by interacting with their web portals, reducing manual intervention.

Next.js: Dynamic Frontend
	•	Provides a user-friendly dashboard for tracking inventory, managing suppliers, and interacting with smart contracts.
	•	Uses API routes to connect frontend functionalities with blockchain interactions.

Base Sepolia: Blockchain for Transparent Operations
	•	Records all inventory-related transactions and updates on-chain for transparency.
	•	Supports wallet integration for secure user authentication and contract interactions.
Hosted on vercel, supabase and railway.
This streamlined tech stack enables Storagent to deliver AI-driven inventory management with Web3 integration while maintaining security, transparency, and user convenience.
